It had slightly fast speed and a decently high health for its speed. On top of this, it also summons in the [[Stunt Man Double]], which effectively is the same enemy but smaller and with less health. ==Logbook Description== "''This daredevil was once a celebrated stunt performer, known for their death-defying acts and fearless attitude. However, a tragic accident during a high-risk stunt left them trapped in a liminal space between life and death. Now, they roam the battlefield, driven by an insatiable urge to perform their stunts, regardless of the consequences.''" ==Appearance== The '''Stunt Man''' is a daredevil with a black body. It wears a red vest, pants and hat, all with gold accents. It also has a white shirt and frilled gloves, black shoes and a white mask. On its death, its [[Stunt Man Double|double]] will jump out of it. It has two walking animations to choose from. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *The '''Stunt Man''' can summon its [[Stunt Man Double]], which can only happen upon death. **The [[Hacker]] can negate its ability, preventing it from summoning the [[Stunt Man Double]]. *High DPS towers, like the [[Turret]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Warlock]] and [[Pursuit]] are recommended against this. *The '''Stunt Man''' is quite fast, making stalling towers like the [[Freezer]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Electroshocker]] useful against it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} StuntManSpawn.gif|Spawning animation, first variant (20 December 2025 – Present) StuntManSpawn2.gif|Spawning animation, second variant (20 December 2025 – Present) StuntManWalk.gif|Walking animation, first variant (20 December 2025 – Present) StuntManWalk2.gif|Walking animation, second variant (20 December 2025 – Present) StuntManDeath.gif|Death animation, first variant (20 December 2025 – Present) StuntManDeath2.gif|Death animation, second variant (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseStuntMan.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (20 December 2025 – Present) CorpseStuntMan2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} StuntManIconIG.png|'''Stunt Man''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Stunt Man''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' -
